_comment: Phase 4.15B: startup-only synchronisation. Each time the backend is launched it makes ONE refresh attempt (one full-season request per league: OpenLigaDB Bundesliga and La Liga only); there is no recurring scheduler. periodic_minutes is ignored in this mode. To go back to the six-hour scheduler set sync_mode to periodic, enable the FootIQ-Backend task and restart (docs/mini-project/phase4/P4_15_STARTUP_ONLY_SYNC.md). To switch live access off set live_enabled to false and restart.
